experiments: novelty-p2-dial; novelty-followup-ignition; r2-run2-six-patterns; r2-run3-min-outside-data; r2-run5-required-pools; r3-run1..run4b
claim: RL on f = 0 pattern pools ignites a pattern only from a nonzero pre-RL rate, or from rewarded neighbours / one injected proof
key_numbers: r2-run2: 0/6 patterns from zero-rate draws; r2-run5: zero-rate draws 0/300 vs nonzero draw 51/300 (frozen 4); r3-run1: neighbour pools ignite 9/16 vs 1/16; r3-run4b: EI acquires 206-231 required targets outside base 10^4 reach (with neighbours)
caveats: token format, nd_verify; 'zero-rate' draws do emit the pattern at 6-7 lines (r3-run2/3); r3-run4b confounds size, schedule and LR; base reachability at 10^4-6x10^5 attempts

claim: The token-format 'RL composes depth-3 from zero' was partly a surface barrier
key_numbers: lean_seq frozen base writes depth-3 for 13-28 % of targets (token 0.5 %); run4-grpo-review: GRPO ignites 12/12 arms from 0 in 8.56x10^5 samples (token, nd_verify)
direction: elicitation (in lean_seq); creation-like in token format only
caveats: run4-grpo-review checkpoints lost, ~70 % of the pattern is vacuous box nesting; lean-format two seeds

claim: EI solves theorems its base never reached
key_numbers: 29 theorems at 0 / 4x10^5 base attempts solved by EI at p 0.02-0.9995; seed 1 replicates 29/29; 10^7 base attempts reach 1 of the 6 longest; teacher-forced p <= 9.5e-8; no pass@k crossover to k = 10^4
direction: creation relative to this whole-proof base
caveats: one 3.2M base family, 2 seeds; the 25M control is a weaker prover, so 'not removed by 8x params' does not test a stronger base; improbability sits in 2-3 steps
model: 3.2M lean_seq whole-proof, scratch, cap-6 depth3 f0 a1 155k (stage1_a1_seq s0/s1; EI la_T1_sc r8); 25.3M base control

claim: The same survivors are reachable without RL by a proof-state base
key_numbers: SN base reaches 28/29 survivors per seed; a state model writing its own names reaches 25-28/29; EI still expands SN support (30 theorems at 4x10^4, 7 at 2x10^5 per temperature, L_true 7-11)
direction: elicitation via interface for the whole-proof survivors; weak creation one level up
caveats: n = 1 for S1/S2; the two SN base seeds differ 20x in p; state and env-assigned naming confounded (state-readouts separates them)
model: 3.2M lean_staten SN-v2 (and S/SH) cap 6, scratch, cap-6 control 155k

experiments: ladder-A; cap-horizon; long-pool; long-pool-2; state-frontier; state-cap12; best-state

key_numbers: ladder-A L* 7 -> 10 every rung (one tower family); cap-horizon T1 L* = 12 at every cap; long-pool: cap-12/14 Stage-1 without RL (88/118 of 600) beats every T1 except SN-v2 s0; state passes L_true >= 13 at 2.12 % on 4 theorems
caveats: L_true labels are ND-derived upper bounds under Lean; transfer2285 caps L* at 14 (pool wall); no noise floor for long pools; see length_frontier.csv

key_numbers: SN-cap12 T1 37.25 vs frozen 28.25 of 72 (paired, MDD ~7.4); best-cap12 T1 51.7 vs ours 37.5 with frozen level (+1.2, inside MDD)

claim: The eventual proof's worst step climbs during pretraining and RL
key_numbers: cap 12: worst step +4.1 nats in pretraining (after step 1,600), +4.6 in RL, base pass@256 ~0.15; cap 6: Delta_RL +8.8 vs Delta_PT +2.2, base pass@256 ~0.07
caveats: n = 3; 'eventual proof' chosen as the final model's most likely sample biases Delta_RL up (cap 6 also selection-free targets); truncation > 0.1 % in 494/792 strata (cap 6)
model: 9.56M best-cap12 lean_staten s0-s2 (66 ckpts), scratch, K12 155k; cap-6: best-cap6 checkpoints (see trajectory-cap6)

claim: Starting RL earlier in pretraining does not reach anything the end arm does not
key_numbers: early-start ladders never exceed the end arm in selection-free reach; reach the end arm from step 5,000
caveats: decisive test written after the pre-registered one failed; ladder replay ~476M tokens (> Stage-1) makes an early start also more pretraining; replay-only controls not token-matched (1.33-1.63x)
model: 9.56M best-cap12 lean_staten s0-s2 intermediate checkpoints, scratch, K12 155k

claim: RL banks proofs the base reaches rarely
key_numbers: novelty-p1: 348/1,411 RL-solved theorems outside base 10^4 reach, nine-line proofs p < 1e-5 with surprisal in one line; june: EI 747 vs resampling 607/1200; cap-comparison: 0/43 textbook targets beyond cap 6
caveats: pre-Lean verifiers (June verifier unsound: forward subproof refs); 1 seed; reach measured at 10^4 attempts only

claim: The RL gain depends on the base, not only on its frozen level
key_numbers: best-cap12 frozen level with ours (+1.2) yet +14 after the same RL; compute-match: matched ladder GPU time does not close the gap; ds-generator G2: lower frozen rate, larger EI gain
caveats: Stage-1 compute not matched (ours 1.74x best's); best arms truncated up to 4 %; ds-generator inside the floor

claim: A stronger expert or better-targeted supply does not make a better apprentice
key_numbers: search-expert: best-first ties sampling at 1/4 spend; frontier-supply +7.5/291 (MDD 10.5); Robbie TTRL at 5x: targets-only EI 1,088 vs TTRL 1,079 vs sample-more 1,020 of 1,108 dev
caveats: matched on budget, not spend; inside MDD; Robbie's dev metric at T 0.8, Lean and nd_verify
